actions.opportunity_summary: AJ brings lived educator experience on Graphy plus systems thinking across product, teaching, and creator business models. He could help shape educator onboarding, AI-enabled creator workflows, and product strategy grounded in real classroom and course-creation friction.
why_recommended: Company intelligence brief is available to ground outreach.
Intelligence entry points suggest a concrete collaboration path.
AJ has firsthand product experience that supports a insight-led opening.

email.subject: Product leadership contact — opportunity to explore Creator Education Founder in Residence with Graphy
email.body:
Hello Product leadership contact,

I have been following Graphy's work — Graphy is an India-based creator-economy platform that helps educators, coaches, and experts launch and monetize online courses, memberships, and live learning experiences.

As someone with direct experience in this space, I would like to share a few practical insights that may be useful to your team.

My background spans systems thinking, product strategy, ai transformation, innovation, and I am especially interested in founder-led environments where multipotentialite operators can connect ideas, products, and systems.

Would you be open to a short conversation?

Best,
Ankit
